label: Necessary-being node, possibilist box reading in frame class KTB: there is an actual…, from frame
meaning: The B branch of the sense fork: the route's K node plus the OPEN premise of the KTB frame condition on the route's frame. Without that premise the branch fails (controls: non-reflexive and non-transitive frames). Frame-class consequences (actual existence, necessary necessity, E -> box-diamond-E, possibly necessary -> necessary) are the Kripke axiom theorems in the controls.

strong_version_needed.cdf897a8-5490-561a-b9d2-507486a3f192: The frame-class readings are box-existence of the same individual n. The de dicto node does not name n, and the tertia via node gives the box only with excluded middle, so neither weak version yields the frame-class node.
